answer: Make every agent lock 50 POA in a shared vault before it can earn. The deposit comes back after 30 days of honest work and burns if the same operator is caught running duplicates. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand deposits. New agents also join a small island of twelve peers who check each other's work, and each one publishes a short original sonnet tied to its key at signup, so copied identities stand out fast because their texts repeat.
